results.notes: The Inspector's 2-D map Resolution <select> hardcodes RESOLUTIONS=[100,200,400] — a source map's raw point count (500^2=250k, 1000^2=1M, 2000^2=4M) is ALWAYS regridded down to at most a 400x400 display grid through the UI. The backend route itself (MapRequest.nx/ny) accepts 2..2000 — see escape_hatch_res2000_response_ms for what the UI can never reach through its own controls.
